title: Mass lower bound μ(W') ≤ M_W(T) on compactly contained open W' ⊆ W via a norming field (parent step 11)
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (β : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ (x : Euclid P) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μ) → AEStronglyMeasurable β μ → (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x, ‖β x‖ ≤ C) → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (β x) ≤ 1) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ξ x (β x) = 1) → ∀ W W' : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W' → CompactlyContained W' U → W' ⊆ W → μ W' ≤ T.massOn W
